llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and low-risk: it only contains a small shell helper that prints prompt templates and echoes user input, and it asks for no credentials or system access. Before installing, consider that the author/source is unknown and there's no homepage—if you need higher assurance, review icp.sh yourself or request a verified publisher; also treat any guidance from the skill as informational (not legal advice) and validate it against official ICP filing resources or a qualified provider.
